$comment: The rundown template, version 1, structure only (CAS-004, D40). The owner
supplied it on 22 October 2026 from the standing Cyberattack Sunday rules.
One template serves the cyberattack and the crypto round-up: the lane
changes the category filter and the extras, never the entry shape. No
article text lives here. The generator fills the slots below from the
recorded fields of the selected stories and invents nothing; the owner
edits the result. The file is canonicalized and hashed at load; every
generated revision records the hash it was produced under.

sections.title: Rundown
sections.rule: One entry per selected incident, in selection order. The generator does not reorder; sequencing stays editorial.

sections.title: Extras
sections.marker: <!-- extras: Stories From This Week That Show The Bar Is Now In Hell; intro, outro and lead-story sequencing stay manual -->
sections.rule: No slot beyond the marker. The owner writes these by hand.

sections.title: Flagged, not published
sections.rule: Items omitted as non-cyber or out of lane with a one-line reason, and late arrivals carried to the next week per D10. Surfaced for owner override, never silently dropped.

headline.rule: The organization name and every key detail sit in the summary body, not the headline.

rules: Written as a standalone audio script: the organization name and every key detail sit in the body.
A clickbait lead in the first one to four words.

sources.label: Sources:
sources.rule: The label on its own line, then each full URL on its own line, no link text, no previews.

deduplication.rule: One entry per incident; the summary draws on every member row; every member row's URL is listed under Sources in row order; no duplicate markers in the output; matching within the editorial week only, never across weeks.
